facts.fact: Cameroon's FY2025 finance law appropriates FCFA 1,567,500,000 for programme 026 Modernisation du cadastre, whose objective is a digital national cadastre, tracked by the share of communes with a digital cadastral plan, says the Ministry of Finance.
